correctness.rationale: For a matching M, its one-step infection closure F_M is union-preserving and idempotent. Thus collapsing repeated identical snapshots leaves the final set unchanged; an alternating sequence of two perfect matchings is specified by the first color and r=1+#switches. On a 2m-vertex alternating-cycle component, the first occupied matching edge i infects a contiguous 2r-vertex interval after r compressed snapshots (capped at 2m). A union of these intervals covers the component iff the cyclic gaps between nonempty first-matching edges are all ≤r. Counting occupied edge sets by marking one edge and distributing m as s gaps of sizes 1..r yields C_{m,r}(s)=m/s[x^{m-s}](1+...+x^{r−1})^s; the three nonempty seed patterns per occupied matching edge contribute 2z+z², hence the product all-cardinality polynomial. The minimum successful number is Σ ceil(m_j/r), with minimum-count Π 2^{s_j}C_{m_j,r}(s_j); shared matching edges (m=1), r≥m, and zero snapshots are handled distinctly. Under independent initial vertex infection, each first-matching edge is occupied with probability q=1−(1−p)², and the maximal vacant run has asymptotic length log(m)/(−log(1−q)) by disjoint blocks and union bound. Independent simulation of all 2^(2m) initial sets for m=1..5 across multiple schedules reproduced every full final set, success criterion and polynomial coefficient, without substituting finite tests for the general proof.

value.rationale: A natural family of temporal propagation graphs collapses from arbitrarily long schedules to the initial matching and a single switch-count statistic. The theorem goes beyond minimum-size zero forcing, giving a factored all-cardinality enumerator, precise extremizer multiplicities and a probability asymptotic. Those are independently useful exact invariants for temporal infection and controllability questions, and the restriction to two fixed perfect matchings is motivated by their decomposable alternating-cycle geometry.
